description: Eau Gallie Electric, Inc. is a Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned small business located in sunny Melbourne, Florida.  We have been around since 1948 supporting all of Central Florida's residential and commercial electrical needs.  We specialize in generator installation and repair, electrical service work, NAVAIDS, UPS installation and upgrades, and electrical construction projects.  Our vision is to provide superior service through high-quality electrical solutions.  Our driving forces are integrity and faith.  We maintain a set of core values that we use as the foundation for our company: cleanliness, neat work, high-quality, and attention to detail are hallmarks of our service.  We value our customers and our employees as the backbone of our business and our mission will always be to answer God's call to change lives.
